warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4-5-6 at 3.00 + 3.00 + 2.00 + 1.00 + 3.00 (12.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 3.00 + 1.50 + 4.00 + 2.00 (10.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04 and the building sections A-07/A-08. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

Every printed tick became a line per section 4 rule 4: S-01/S-02 add 1'' (2.00), 2' (3.50), 5'' (10.30), A' (-1.60), C' (5.10); the roof sheets S-03/S-04 add the 1.00 eave overhangs (1', 6', A'', E') and the wall-plate / king-post / ridge ticks (2'', 2''', 3', 5', A''', A'''', B', C'', C''', C'''', C''''', D'). Dummy names follow position order, so 2.00 is 1'' (the -1.00 overhang is 1') and 10.30 is 5'' (9.88 is 5').

S-03 and S-04 both print 0.88 + 2.13 between grids 5 and 6 (sums to 3.01 against the 3.00 printed directly above). 5' is placed 0.88 from grid 5 (9.88); the 0.01 is carried by the 2.13 segment — a rounding in the drawing.

The two 0.125 ticks on S-03 (A''' at 2.125 next to A'''' 2.25, and C'''' at 6.375 next to C''' 6.25) are printed dimensions, so they are lines; they mark king-post / wall-plate positions offset 0.125 from the neighbouring tick.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับดินถม (A-07/A-08; A-01 notes: ระดับดินถมภายในโครงการ). The label ระดับหลังอกไก่ is printed with three values (+5.39, +5.53, +6.54), so those three ids carry the value to stay distinct. ระดับดินเดิม (S-05) and ระดับดิน (S-06) print no value — kept with level_m null; the 1.00 / 0.50 / 0.05 / 0.05 footing depths stay on the footing elements.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06 plus the building sections A-07/A-08 (levels). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 floor plan, A-04 roof plan, A-05/A-06 elevations, A-09, A-10 opening sizes, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05/S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (section sizes, cap sizes, slab thicknesses, stair riser/tread), which stay on their elements.
